observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (4927 x 2667) blurred 3x3, in nine tiles at full size with a 0.02 grid and close-ups with a 0.01 grid (some with local contrast raised), against a reference render of the cabin from about the right place (not the photo's camera: the photo has no view yet)
covers: the cab seen forward from the compartment's aisle: SL-1M's forward end under the cloth and the wall under it, the left windscreen pillar, the header with its loom, plate and visors, both screens and the centre post, the steering wheel, the dash (centre panel, toggle panel, DP-3B), both front seats from behind with their bags, the floor mat, the left R-123M under its tread cover, the right R-123M on the big box, the hanging grey box, the curtain's right half and the raised step
notes: Statuses are read against the reference render and the cabin data (data/cabins/osa_ak.json shell, the register's cabin field), not a render from this photo's camera; places in the render were not compared. Contradictions: box.zczz1a_1's model (spares_1) is small and in the compartment (y 2.32), where the photo has a big box under the right R-123M in the cab; the seats' backs are bare steel pans with a hoop, not padded olive seats with two uprights; the visors hang down, the model's are folded up; the render's wiper motor at the left screen's lower left is not in the photo, the photo's grey cylinder is at the header's right end.

details.what: yellow-tan cloth draped over the top of SL-1M's forward end: a straight folded lower edge running diagonally from the frame's left edge up to the header's corner, two long shallow creases parallel to it; it hides the rack's top block
details.size_cue: the folded edge about as long as the rack's two blocks are high
details.note: Taken by the observer to be the curtain's left half pushed aside over the rack; it may be a separate dust sheet.

details.what: the rack's forward edge: a narrow light grey upright at the blocks' forward ends, a round fitting on it at the meter block and a round connector at the fuse block
details.size_cue: about as wide as the round connector beside it

details.what: an upright further aft at the frame's left edge: a light grey channel with a knurled round fitting at the lower block's mid-height, a dark cable loop beside it
the rail between the upper and lower blocks: a dark recessed channel across the face, the upper block's lower lip over it
details.size_cue: about a toggle guard's height
details.note: The reference render shows dark bars across SL-1M's faces; their places are not checked from this camera.

details.what: the rack's foot: a dark steel bottom rail under the lower block and, under it, a dark grey face (the rack's base) down to the shelf's edge
a moving-coil meter with a light dial in a black square bezel standing proud of the face; beyond it a black rotary selector with a pointer knob and a small round knob
details.size_cue: the meter about a fist across
details.note: The model's SL-1M has flat block faces.

details.what: a long narrow red-brown vertical strip beside the selector (a multi-pin connector's insulator or a fuse strip)
the legends round the selector (rows of small black text), a small type plate at the face's upper forward corner and a yellowish brass plate at the face's foot
two pairs of toggle switches in light guard brackets across the upper part of the lower block
details.size_cue: each guard about a finger long

details.what: a row of about sixteen fuse caps along the block's foot, the middle ones larger and orange-brown, the end ones small and dark red, a chrome guard bracket across the row
printed legend brackets and numbers over the fuse row
round chrome connectors at the lower block's aft side and at its forward edge, and a small black square window
screw heads scattered over both block faces (corners and fixings)
details.size_cue: heads a fraction of a fuse cap

details.what: below the rack's foot the wall steps out: the top edge of a shelf or sponson running under the rack, and from it a broad surface sloping down toward the aisle to behind the left radio
details.size_cue: the sloping band about as deep as the rack's lower block is high
details.note: The reference render shows no step under SL-1M's foot.

details.what: a plate edge running diagonally across the sloping surface
the sloping surface's paint: grey worn to brown, heavily scuffed and dusty
a brown leather strap with a buckle hanging over the slope's edge at the frame's left
small white P-clips and tags on the slope and the rack's base
a round gauge with a white dial and a bright rim on a light blue square flange, forward of the rack's foot; a light wire bail and a brown strap across its foot
details.size_cue: about a fist across
details.note: The light blue square flange is instrument.gauge_by_pu303's (g084); if it is that gauge it is at the dash's left end beyond the pillar, not on the left wall.

details.what: two grey boxes between the left radio and the pillar's foot: one with a row of screw terminals along its top, the other with a black round knob in a square recess; a black cable arches over them
details.note: Possibly the R-124 A-4 box (intercom.a4, modelled at x -0.70, y 3.75) or the BP-26; not legible here.

details.what: a yellow cylinder with a narrower stepped neck and a white label patch with dark letters on its side, standing on the slope beside the left radio
details.size_cue: about a hand tall
details.note: Probably the same canister as kit.canister_n542 (g091).

details.what: a red-painted rod or sleeve with a white cap at its top, standing between the left radio's cover and the driver's seat
details.note: Perhaps the fire system's red pull (kit.fire_system_bottles) or a red-sleeved cable.

details.what: the left windscreen pillar: a light grey pressed channel leaning inboard from the header's corner down to the dash, bending into the header at the top with a radius about its own width, flanges on both edges
details.size_cue: about a hand wide
details.note: The render shows a plain upright frame with two black rods at the screen's left edge.

details.what: two large round lightening holes in the web outboard of the pillar, one above the other
details.size_cue: each about twice the SL-1M meter's height across

details.what: the pillar's loom: three or four white cables and a black one bundled down its outboard edge, held by a grey P-clip near the top and a white tie at mid-height, curving inboard to the dash at its foot
details.size_cue: the bundle about a thumb thick

details.what: a grey cast junction box high on the pillar's inboard side: blue wires down from the header into two screw glands at its top, a white-capped gland at its foot, corner screws, a small black toggle lever on its inboard face
details.size_cue: fist-sized

details.what: a knurled brass-coloured round connector on the pillar's face with a cream cable looping down from it and back
a black rectangular block (a terminal strip or relay) on the pillar's inboard side under the junction box
small black plates with white text on the pillar's face, one high and one low
details.size_cue: each about a hand long

details.what: small cream cylinders with dark metal ends held in clips down the pillar's face (cartridge fuses or spare bulbs), five seen
light grey wire rods at the left screen's outboard edge: one upright from the screen's top corner to the dash, Z-bent at its foot, a second standing off the pillar with a hooked end
details.size_cue: about as thick as a pencil
details.note: Perhaps the armoured flaps' rods or stays; bracket.ring_pillar_left is a different part.

details.what: a thick black cable down beside the pillar's inboard edge from the header to the dash
a light grey rounded housing on the roof at the top left, over the pillar's head
details.note: Perhaps the driver's hatch rim (hull.hatch_driver).

details.what: the header across the cab's front: the light grey roof meets a rolled lower lip running the whole width, the windscreen surround below it; the visors' rods hang from it
details.size_cue: the header about as deep as a visor is high

details.what: the header loom: two or three white cables about finger-thick, several blue wires and black and dark brown cables bundled across the whole width, sagging between ties; a loose blue loop hangs under it at the right
details.size_cue: the bundle about as thick as the steering wheel's rim
details.note: The render shows three thin black bars.

details.what: white cable ties round the header loom
details.note: The render has four or five white clips; the photo's ties are at about x 0.275, 0.355, 0.385, 0.415, 0.435, 0.455, 0.545, 0.625, 0.72.

details.what: small grey brackets screwed to the header's lip that hold the loom
a thin pipe in the loom with a brass union, and ring cable lugs on short leads beside it
a black plate with the vehicle's type in white on the header's face at the centre, and a small white plate beside it
details.size_cue: a few hand-widths long

details.what: both visors hang down in front of the screens' tops: pressed light grey plates with a rolled rim and rounded lower corners (radius about a sixth of the visor's height), streaked with dirt
details.size_cue: each about as wide as a seat back
details.note: The render's visors are flat plates folded up under the roof.

details.what: a triangular HB cigarette sticker with a caption strip on the left visor
an oval blue Rothmans sticker on the right visor
the visors' hinge rods along the header, round ball pivots at their ends and a black clip bracket at the middle of each
details.size_cue: the balls about as big as a toggle's knob

details.what: a strip of olive-khaki cloth hanging from the roof at the header's right end, in front of the loom
details.note: Perhaps kit.flag_bag or a strap of the curtain.

details.what: a grey cylinder with a bright round end toward the right wall, on a bracket and a small grey housing at the header's right end above the right screen's outer corner
details.size_cue: about a fist across
details.note: Taken as the register's roof gauge (g087-d, g089) seen edge-on; it could be a wiper motor (motor.wiper). The render's wiper motor sits at the left screen's lower left, where this photo shows none.

details.what: a fitting under it and a thin grey pipe down past the screen's outer corner, an orange-tagged length near the top, then down along the right pillar's inboard edge to the dash

the screens' openings: big rounded corners (radius about a sixth of the opening's height) with a dark rubber seal, in a light grey pressed surround; the glass reads dark grey-green (the armoured flaps closed outside, or a dull sky)

the centre post: a pressed member a few cm wide at mid-height, flaring at top and bottom into the surround with the screens' corner radii, a flange down each side, a thin blue wire down its left flange near the top
details.size_cue: about a third as wide as a visor is high
details.note: The render shows two separate frames with a thin dark bar between them.

details.what: the right screen's catch: a horizontal bolt from the post to the screen's inboard edge with a knob and a pin, and a vertical rod down that edge ending in a long wire loop
a hinged clamp at the centre post's foot
details.note: The render has a ring and a small block at the post's foot.

details.what: the wipers outside the glass: a light diagonal arm and blade across the left screen, a short one in the right
a small clamp on the right screen's lower frame
the dash's top: a light grey ledge under the screens with a step at its front edge, the driver's part above the wheel with horizontal grooves
a black wheel with a thick rim, a large black hub cap and thick spokes (one up-left, one to the right, the third hidden)
details.size_cue: about 0.5 m across
details.note: The render's wheel has thin spokes and a small hub.

details.what: the centre panel: a near-white plate with four round gauges in its top row (the first hidden by the wheel, the third a tachometer with a pale blue ring bezel), a gauge, a chrome knob and a labelled round indicator below, two small black buttons and a grey round lamp
details.size_cue: gauge bezels about a fist across
details.note: The render has four grey discs in a square on a flat plate.

details.what: small black legend plates over the gauges, and the dials' printing
screws at the corners and edges of the centre panel and the toggle plate
the toggle panel: a black strip with nine toggles in one row on a light grey plate
details.size_cue: the strip about a third of a seat back's width
details.note: The render has two rows of twelve small squares.

details.what: a short white legend over each toggle and a legend strip under the row
small upright tubular handles at the panels' edges: two between the centre panel and the toggle panel, one beyond it
details.size_cue: about as long as a gauge is wide

details.what: the DP-3B at the dash's right end: a grey box with a square meter window, a round knob, a green and a red lamp and a black rotary switch
details.size_cue: about the size of a gauge pair

details.what: a bent strap bracket with a threaded stud hanging the DP-3B from the ledge
a black rubber-gripped upright grab handle right of the DP-3B

the right windscreen pillar, the left one's mirror: a light grey pressed member upright under the header, then leaning inboard down to the dash's right end; the gauge's pipe and the grab handle on its inboard side
details.size_cue: about a hand wide
details.note: Perhaps frame.windscreen_right_diagonal_bar (g087-b); the render shows a plain upright frame at the right screen's edge.

details.what: under the centre dash the space is open to the floor: a dark recess between the seats with rods, hoses, a cable loop and the gear lever
details.note: The render fills it with a light grey block.

details.what: two blue hoses and a black cable loop under the dash
an upright grey rod with a coil-spring section and clevises from under the dash down to the floor at the mat's edge
details.size_cue: about a finger thick
details.note: The render's grey rod with a plate between the seats may be its stand-in, or the handbrake.

details.what: the gear lever: a black pear-shaped ball knob on a straight steel lever between the seats
details.size_cue: knob fist-sized

details.what: a red-orange painted block at the rod's foot on the mat's forward edge
details.note: May be the end of sponson.channel_between_seats (orange-brown, g088).

details.what: the driver's backrest: an unpadded grey pressed-steel pan, nearly square, big-radius top corners (about a sixth of its width), a rolled rim along its top, a broad shallow pressed field inside, side flanges with screws
details.size_cue: about 0.45 m wide
details.note: The model's seats are olive padded seats; the photo's backs are bare steel pans.

details.what: the commander's backrest, as the driver's
the pans' paint (both seats): light blue-grey, scuffed, the top rims worn to olive-brown
details.note: The model's seats are olive.

details.what: a T-knob latch in a slotted escutcheon at each backrest's upper middle
details.size_cue: about a toggle's size

details.what: each back's tubular hoop: an inverted U of light grey tube across the back's lower half, its legs running down past the pan's foot
details.size_cue: the tube about as thick as the gear lever
details.note: The model has two straight black uprights on each back.

details.what: the hoops' lug plates, each with two screws, fixing them to the pans
a triangular HB sticker with a caption on the commander's backrest's upper right
a khaki canvas gas-mask bag on the commander's hoop: a flap, a dark leather tab with two studs, a khaki web strap hanging down its inboard side
details.size_cue: about half the seat back

details.what: a khaki canvas bag on the driver's hoop, partly behind the left radio's cloth
the seats' bases: upright flat-bar frames with clevises and pins, each foot on a grey plate with holes bolted to the floor
horizontal tubes along the seats' bases, and an olive-painted bar with a bolt under the driver's
a black ribbed rubber mat across the aisle from the seats' feet toward the camera: fine ribs across the vehicle, about forty over its depth
details.size_cue: about as wide as both seats together

details.what: round screw heads along the mat's forward and aft edges (about seven on each)
a bright aluminium strip across the floor aft of the mat (a nosing on a step, or a plate joint)
the floor's paint: light grey, dusty and scuffed, dead leaves on it
the left radio's steel tread cover: a big grey plate with raised diagonal tread beads over its top
details.size_cue: as long as the radio
details.note: The model's cover is a flat 6 mm plate.

details.what: its aft edge turned down in a deep flange over the radio's end
round screw heads on the cover's top
the radio's aft end: a light grey case face with two upright swaged beads
details.note: If this face is the R-123M's case end (its front faces the aisle); it could be the BP-26's.

details.what: a black plate with a white type designation and two screws at the top of that face
a yellow-tan canvas dust cloth over the radio under the steel cover, hanging either side of the end face to the mount and bunched at its foot
the radio's front to the aisle, foreshortened: dials, knobs and a red tag
the shock mount under the radio: two stacked spring plates at its aft end, a base tray with a U-channel under it fixed by two hex nuts, a chrome shock absorber, a side rail
a light aluminium bracket of flat bars at the radio's forward inboard corner: a horizontal top bar and two diagonal legs to the floor
a silver braided screened cable hanging from under the radio to the floor
details.size_cue: thumb-thick

details.what: a white cylindrical sleeve with a red band on the left wall low, pointing down and inboard
a thick bundle of white cables curving down the wall under the slope, a black cable across it
grey cables lying on the floor at the lower left
the right radio's front: frequency dial windows, a red knob, latches down its right side
an olive canvas cover over the radio's top, hanging over the front's upper left corner in a diagonal fold
a brown leather loop hanging from a light grey bar at the top right over the radio
details.note: The bar may be handle.roof_over_radio_right_fwd's.

details.what: the shock mount under the right radio: a sloping tray plate with three round silver shock absorbers, cables clamped under it
white cables with a blue tag down from under the radio

the big box under the right radio: as high as the seat back and longer than it, standing on the raised step; its inboard face foreshortened to the left, its aft face to the camera, the radio's mount on its top
details.size_cue: about as high as the seat back, longer than it
details.note: The model's spares_1 (box.zczz1a_1) is a small box 0.13 x 0.31 x 0.21 m at y 2.32 in the compartment; here the box stands directly under the right R-123M (y about 3.2), in the cab.

details.what: an X of swaged beads on the inboard face: one from its forward top corner to its aft bottom corner, the other from the aft top corner to the middle (its lower half faint)
a data plate at the inboard face's forward upper corner: a dark brown plate in a lighter frame with four screws
details.size_cue: about a hand across

details.what: an over-centre toggle latch with a chrome hook plate and a black lever near the aft face's top
the box's aft upright corner: a folded flange, and a second upright line on the aft face (a rim or a lid's edge)
three short light upright strips along the inboard face's lower edge (fixing brackets or feet)
the box's metal: dull grey aluminium, the aft face bright in the flash, the inboard face darker (in shade, or painted olive-grey)
a light grey box tilted about 20 degrees, hanging on the big box's aft face at its right, an olive band along its top edge
details.size_cue: shoebox-sized

details.what: two lines of dark stencilled text on its face
an olive-green round object (a lid, a bag's bottom or a canteen) behind the hanging box
the curtain's right half gathered at the right wall: deep upright folds above, tied, then a bunched bulge down to below the box's top
details.size_cue: hangs from roof height nearly to the floor

details.what: a white cloth tie round the gathered curtain, its tail hanging

the raised step along the right side under the box: a dark plate whose inboard edge runs diagonally aft toward the camera, the mat's right end cut against it, a light grey face at its aft end lit by the flash
details.size_cue: knee-high

details.what: a row of bolt heads along the step's sloping edge
a grey cable looping down over the step's edge
a dark oval hole in the floor plate at the step's foot
details.size_cue: about a hand across

details.what: the step and the floor at the right: dark worn paint, scuffed and dusty, dead leaves
